title: addon harbor (platform keys; harbor.* is the upstream chart's)

type.description: Must be harbor; templates/validate.yaml tells how to disable the addon for registry.type external.

host.description: <name>[:port] used in image refs, Harbor externalURL and node pulls. Format checked only with registry.type harbor (otherwise validate.yaml says to disable the addon).

appsProject.description: Harbor project in-cluster builds push to.

proxyCache.description: Pull-through caches: upstream registry -> Harbor project (upstream needs a config.endpoints entry).

registry.description: installation.yaml registry: the platform registry this addon serves.

store.description: ClusterSecretStore the Harbor Secrets are read from.

remoteKey.description: Store key with Harbor's generated secrets.

ghcrKey.description: Store key with GHCR credentials for private ghcr.io packages ("" = none).

secretName.description: Secret the upstream chart's existingSecret* keys point at.

secrets.description: ExternalSecret inputs for Harbor's admin/DB/robot secrets.

caIssuer.description: Namespaced Issuer + CA Secret in ns harbor.

tokenSecret.description: JWT signing Secret of Harbor's token service (== harbor.core.secretName).

pki.description: Namespaced CA and the listener/token certificates.

name.description: Gateway the chart's HTTPRoute attaches to.

gateway.description: Gateway API listener in front of Harbor.

harbor.description: Upstream Harbor chart values (not constrained here; cross-checks in templates/validate.yaml).
